description:
Perform a data quality check using the Epi Info 7 Visual Dashboard. 

1. Open the Visual Dashboard.
2. Load the dataset from 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\DiabetesData\diabetes_surveillance.csv'.
3. Create a Scatter Plot with 'BMI' on the Y-axis and 'Glucose' on the X-axis.
4. Visually identify the single patient with an impossible BMI value (extreme outlier).
5. Identify the 'PatientID' for this record.
6. Save the dashboard as 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\DiabetesData\qa_dashboard.canvas7'.
7. Create a text file report at 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\DiabetesData\outlier_report.txt' containing the PatientID and the erroneous BMI value.
